headline: MJ Gleeson Shares Fall as New Housing Scheme Delays Buyer Demand
summary: Shares of UK housebuilder MJ Gleeson dropped as delays surrounding a new homeownership scheme dampened buyer demand.
why: MJ Gleeson plc is a UK-based housing developer focusing on low-cost residential construction.

impacts.name: MJ Gleeson plc
impacts.why: Uncertainty and delays surrounding a new housing scheme reduced buyer demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Delays in a government home buying program dampened demand, pushing MJ Gleeson shares lower.
